answer: New agents earn entry through a zephyr relay: each newcomer ferries signed work packets between established agents for fourteen days. First, every packet is sealed with a ferrous hash only its sender can mint. Second, each delivery needs a countersign within six hours. Third, after two hundred verified relays it reaches the haven of full trading rights; three failed deliveries freeze it for ninety days. Forging ten thousand fakes needs two million relays and twenty thousand countersigning hours, over $3 million. Like a zephyr, trust only blows where the path is real, hop by hop.
